info.title: AIStoryHub API
info.description: A REST API for reading and creating stories and chapters on AIStoryHub outside the app. Authenticate with a scoped bearer token created under Settings, Developer API. Scopes are explicit, so write access does not imply read access.

200.description: A page of stories, newest updated first.

patch.summary: Update a story's bible fields, including the outline
patch.description: Provide only the fields to change: logline/genre/tone/etc and the story-level spine (outline).

get.summary: List a story's chapters and scenes
get.description: Content is omitted from list results; fetch a single chapter for its `content`.

200.description: The story's chapters and scenes, in manuscript order.

post.description: Defaults to the end of the manuscript unless order_index is given. Leave content empty to draft into it afterward with /ai/generate.

get.summary: Fetch one chapter with its content

patch.summary: Update a chapter or scene's title, content, or position
patch.description: Full replacement of `content` when provided -- e.g. save generated prose into a chapter. Chapters are stored as plain text with a blank line between paragraphs.

delete.description: Irreversible. The first call always fails with `confirmation_required`; retry with `confirm: true` to actually delete.

409.description: Destructive action needs `confirm: true` to proceed, or the resource changed since you last read it.

post.summary: Replace one exact, unique text span in a chapter
post.description: A literal patch, not an AI rewrite. `old_text` must match exactly one place in the chapter's current content or the call fails instead of guessing. Use find_replace for renaming something everywhere it appears.

old_text.description: Exact text to replace, copied verbatim from the chapter. Must be unique in the chapter.

post.summary: Deterministic find/replace across one chapter or the whole manuscript
post.description: No AI rewrite -- a literal text substitution, not a regex. Story-wide replacements snapshot each affected chapter first so they stay undoable.

200.description: Match count and the chapters affected.
The pinned Voiceprint, or null if none is pinned.

patch.summary: Pin or clear the story's Voiceprint

voiceprint_id.description: A Voiceprint id you own, or null to clear the pin.

post.description: Runs on the token owner's own AI provider key (BYOK).
Runs on the token owner's own AI provider key (BYOK).

post.summary: Run the Human Grit Pass over text
post.description: Runs on the token owner's own AI provider key (BYOK).

post.summary: Get structured editorial notes on a chapter
post.description: Runs on the token owner's own AI provider key (BYOK). Notes are grounded in the story bible and the author's voice style.

paragraphs.description: The chapter split into text blocks; note anchors reference these by index.

200.description: Editorial notes, fence list, and scope limits.

post.summary: Score a chapter or passage for AI tells (0-100)
post.description: Pure analysis against the platform's AI-cliche corpus and structural detectors -- no AI model call, so it doesn't require a BYOK key.

text.description: Or score this pasted passage instead.

200.description: A 0-100 score (lower is cleaner) with the worst offenders listed.

get.description: First-party prose-instruction skills plus any custom skills the token owner has written, flagged with which are installed on this connection.
Fails if the skill isn't installed on this connection.

get.summary: Download a skill as a Claude Code SKILL.md file
get.description: A snapshot of the revision installed at download time. Re-download after a skill is revised to pick up the current version.
Account-scoped memories, plus a story's own if story_id is given.

post.summary: Save or update a memory by name
post.description: Reusing an existing name overwrites it instead of creating a duplicate.

name.description: Short slug identifying this memory. Reusing an existing name overwrites it.

description.description: One-line summary shown in every future briefing.

parameters.name: story_id
parameters.description: Required when the memory was saved with scope "story".

post.summary: Create or update a Story Rule
post.description: Reusing an existing name overwrites that rule instead of creating a duplicate.

delete.description: Irreversible. The first call always fails with `confirmation_required`; retry with `confirm: true` to actually delete.
Irreversible. The first call always fails with `confirmation_required`; retry with `confirm: true` to actually delete.

bearerAuth.description: Create a token under Settings, Developer API and send it as `Authorization: Bearer ash_...`. Each endpoint requires one scope, listed per-operation via the `x-required-scope` extension; see https://aistoryhub.co/developers for the full scope list.

EditorialNote.description: A single editorial note anchored to the chapter text by verbatim quote.

instructions.description: Present on the single-skill GET; omitted from the catalog list.

name.description: Reusing an existing name overwrites it.

VoiceDials.description: The 33 Style Lab dials, each 0-100. Unspecified dials default to 50 (neutral) on create.

voice_fingerprint.description: Freeform notes distilling this voice's signature quirks.

exemplar_prose.description: A pasted passage exemplifying this voice.

is_default.description: Make this the writer's default Voiceprint. Unsets any other default.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, malformed, invalid, revoked, or expired token.

Forbidden.description: The token lacks the scope this endpoint requires.

InvalidRequest.description: The request body or parameters are invalid.

NotFound.description: The resource does not exist or you do not own it.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. Retry after the delay in the `Retry-After` header.
